About Crossways Family Dental • Established 1983

Over Four Decades of Gentle, Multi-Generational Dental Care in West Toronto.

Our Guiding Mission

"To provide oral health care and treatment plans that are customized to the patient’s individual goals, needs, and circumstances."

Where Roncesvalles, The Junction & High Park Meet

Crossways Family Dental is a family-owned-and-operated clinic in Toronto, Ontario. Established in 1983 by Dr. Krystyna Jarvis and run alongside her daughter Dr. Julia Jarvis, our practice has been proudly serving generations of families across the Crossways community for over 35 years.

Conveniently situated on Floor 2 of The Crossways (2340 Dundas St W) right across from Dundas West Subway Station, our clinic blends European and Canadian academic dental training with a warm, unhurried atmosphere. Patients frequently share that they feel at home from their very first visit—whether bringing a two-year-old for a playful, fear-free first check-up or receiving a thorough digital X-ray walk-through before restorative care.

Transparent & Educational

We show you your digital X-rays chairside, explain every step in plain language, and design practical options that respect your budget.

Anxiety-Free Comfort

Renowned in patient reviews for gentle cleanings, pain-free local anesthesia, and child-friendly introductions to dental tools.

Clinic Founder · Est. 1983
Founder & Family Dentist

Dr. Krystyna Jarvis, DDS

Academy of Medicine in Poznań · Canadian Dental Equivalency

Dr. Krystyna Jarvis was born in Poland and received her dental degree at the Academy of Medicine in Poznań. She practised for several years in Poland before immigrating to Edmonton, Canada.

After completing the Canadian dental equivalency process, Dr. Krystyna moved to Yellowknife to work as a dentist. In 1983, she planted her roots in Toronto and opened the clinic known today as Crossways Family Dental.

"Doctor Krystina Jarvis is an exceptional woman and fantastic dentist. She goes beyond the stars! Not only with explanation, advice, and outstanding dental work..." — Adriana Soudek (Patient Review)
20+ Year Multi-Generational Patient Loyalty
B.Sc. (Hons), DMD
Family & General Dentist

Dr. Julia Jarvis, DMD

McMaster University · Poznań University of Medical Sciences · University of Manitoba

Dr. Julia Jarvis graduated from McMaster University with an Honours Bachelor of Science degree in Biochemistry. She combined her interest in dentistry and life in Europe when she moved to Poland and completed her dental degree at the Poznań University of Medical Sciences.

Dr. Julia continued her dental education at the University of Manitoba, where she received her DMD degree. After graduating, she joined the family business alongside Dr. Krystyna Jarvis.

"Julia is one of the best dentists I have come across. She has such a good hand in dentistry. She is so gentle and kind. She keeps you well informed..." — Rinku Gala (Local Guide)
Known for Pain-Free Care & Kids' First Check-Ups
